verdict.rationale: Runtime probes confirm a live llms.txt at metorial.com/llms.txt that indexes the full docs tree, covering build, platform and API reference. It also documents that every docs page mirrors as clean markdown at URL + .mdx, and a fetch of the quickstart .mdx confirms the mirror works. An OpenAPI spec is served at /openapi.json, so an agent can be pointed at machine-readable docs directly. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs, and the /docs.md convention returns 404.
